title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-08-30
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Landmark Dark Star performance with strong improvisation; recording source unknown but musically compelling
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as a pivotal moment in the Dead’s evolution, highlighted by an adventurous Dark Star and the first ever Tighten Up (Soulful Strut) jam. While the reviewer notes Jerry’s broken string, his recovery fuels a triumphant passage that makes this recording a treasure for fans despite no specific comments on audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review praises the musical performance heavily; lack of recording details keeps confidence low, but the strong show quality pushes the rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer comments on sound clarity, mix, or source; unable to assess technical fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A groundbreaking improvisational stretch that moves from a daring Dark Star into an uplifting, triumphant climax, marking a major creative leap for the band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar issues noted (broken string) but his recovery and tone are praised as remarkable.
